content.title: Appendix A — Licensing & Pricing
content.content:
**⚠️ Key Requirement: Perpetual License Option**

The RFP explicitly requires a perpetual license option alongside any subscription pricing. This is non-negotiable for Airbus. Pricing must include both models clearly labelled.

**Pricing Structure to Include**

- **Option A — Perpetual License**: One-time license fee + annual maintenance & support (typically 20–25% of license). Broken down by component (Ground Plex nodes, Manager)

- **Option B — Annual Subscription**: Per-year SaaS/subscription pricing. Include multi-year discount tiers (3-year, 5-year)

- **Professional Services**: Implementation services (T&M or fixed-deliverable), training, managed services

- **Training**: Developer Essentials, Citizen Developer workshops, SnapLogic University access
